en: Each guest shows the hairdo they want on the Wants card. Look closely: 5 things must match.
Comb changes the style (curly, spiky, smooth), Fringe changes the bangs, Spray changes the finish (plain, shiny, glitter).
Tap a colour drop to dye it and an accessory to pop it on.
There is no match meter: you only see how close you got when you tap Done! (or time runs out).
Under 80% (fewer than 4 of 5 right) makes a guest unhappy. 3 unhappy guests and it is over. Guests get less patient forever.
